'''G0-T0's Droid Army''' was the amalgamation of droids across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], centered in [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and on [[G0-T0]]'s personal yacht, the ''[[Visionary]]'', loyal to him and ready to bring any [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] or [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] that they find to him as per their programmed orders.

G0-T0 was responsible for every thing wrong with the droids on the Smugglers' Moon, controlling them with a [[Central Control Computer/Legends|Central Control Computer]] aboard the yacht. When the ''Visionary'' was [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (First Jedi Purge)|destroyed]], G0-T0's control ended and the droids' behavior was back to normal.
